evidence.quote: All modules are taught in English.
You do not have to pay any tuition fees in Rheinland-Pfalz.
Applications with foreign academic qualifications must be submitted via the uni-assist platform.

notes: The DAAD page gives application periods for all countries (summer: 1 October - 28 February; winter: 15 April - 31 August), but without a year, so no intake dates were output; the deadlines page states only day and month for open-entry Bachelor courses (August 31st for the winter semester, February 28th for the summer semester). The 'CV' quote is a bare 2-character label copied from the checklist. 'Certified translations of your certificates' implies translation but does not itself state a translation requirement, so translationRequired is null there; the school-leaving-certificate row is quoted from the same checklist sentence, so no separate translation quote exists.

note.fr: Vérifiez si votre Baccalauréat marocain est reconnu pour étudier en Allemagne; sinon, un Studienkolleg et un test d'évaluation peuvent être requis.
note.en: Check whether your Moroccan Baccalaureate is recognised for study in Germany; if not, a Studienkolleg and an assessment test may be required.

evidence.quote: It is essential that you check whether you meet the entry requirements for your desired course of study.

note.fr: Demandez une vérification préliminaire (VPD) de vos diplômes par uni-assist: des frais de 75 euros s'appliquent (30 euros pour chaque candidature suivante).
note.en: Request a preliminary review (VPD) of your certificates via uni-assist: a fee of 75 euros applies (30 euros for each subsequent application).

evidence.quote: The fee for the first application via uni-assist is 75 Euros. Each subsequent application costs 30 Euros.
